ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.
